phase: V2-2 Workstream B WTA Match Winner
dataset: data/interim/v2_wta_market_dataset.csv (scripts/build_v2_wta_market_dataset.py; 10,352 rows; Betfair source hash prefix e34da4cea6db2a2a; results SHA256SUMS in data/raw/tennis/tennis_court_log_wta)
elo: global Elo, initial 1500, warm-up 2018-2020, k=32 chosen on 2021-23 log loss from grid [16,24,32,40,48,64], frozen
stack_definition: logistic regression on [logit(market_multiplicative), logit(elo_global)] fitted on development years only
selection_rule: default unless a candidate has holdout log loss lower with paired-bootstrap 95% CI (seed 20260923, 2000 resamples) excluding zero
calibration_verdict_rule: slope 95% bootstrap CI (1000 resamples, seed 20260923) includes 1 AND every band with n>=200 has predicted mean inside the realised rate's 99.5% Wilson interval (Bonferroni over 10 bands)
